messages:
maria: Heads-up: scheduling catalog cutover to enable nimbus-1.3 tomorrow at 15:00 PT. Change window 45m. Plan: EU canary (10%) 10m -> US canary (10%) 10m -> global ramp (50%) 10m -> full if green. No other catalog changes during window.

dev-deploy-bot: Deploy queued by maria at 2025-02-12T23:00:00Z. CI: all checks passed. Canary targets: eu-west-1(useless) 10%, us-east-1 10%. Run: https://deploy.internal/run/120398

terry: Quick Q: what's the explicit fallback ladder if we see quality drop? We should pick a deterministic ordering for routing.

katie: Fallback ordering we agreed in planning: 1) pin to model:orion-stable (previous release) 2) fall back to nimbus-1.3-quant (same model, quant variant) 3) route to read-only springboard-ensemble. Pins created via rbctl with a note. Default pin TTL 3h.

maria: Rollback thresholds (auto): any of these during canary triggers immediate pin: - >25% p99 latency increase over baseline OR - +3% absolute error rate on production traffic OR - smoke-eval hallucination regression >4% vs baseline.

ops-bot: Monitoring hooks: latency, errors, hallucination-rate, regen-rate. Pager escalation: if p99 latency >300ms for >3min OR hallucination-regress alert fires -> page SRE.

katie: Note on pins: customer pins override catalog routing. We will notify partners via console banner and API changelog. Also will publish a short release note in #product after global ramp.

sam: During rollbacks, use this sequence: 1) `rbctl pin model:orion-stable --ttl=3h --note="safety rollback"` 2) `rbctl route set catalog://latest -> orion-stable --force` 3) scale down nimbus-1.3 canary pool 4) capture eval snapshot + tags.

dev-deploy-bot: Routing patch applied:
```
rbctl route set catalog://latest -> nimbus-1.3 [canary: eu-west-1=10%, us-east-1=10%]
rbctl verify catalog://latest
```
verification: OK

terry: One more: telemetry baseline used is last 7 days for p99/p95, last 24h for error-rate. Make sure we compare to same traffic mix.

maria: Also: don't forget to disable autoscaling experiments in the canary pools for the window, otherwise we might see noise.

ops-bot: Autoscaling toggled off on canary pools.

katie: I'll be oncall. If I see a rollback signal I'll call it and post the rbctl command here. After rollback we'll run a 30m triage and make a decision about next steps.

maria: Final checklist: preflight smoke (done) :white_check_mark:, dashboards linked :white_check_mark:, partners notified draft ready :white_check_mark:, oncall set (katie) :white_check_mark:.

sam: I'll draft a short release note template to paste here post-ramp with observed metrics and any anomalies.

maria: Perfect. Keep updates concise during window. If anything weird, trigger rollback early. :thumbsup:
